verdict.rationale: Smithery's core product function is being an MCP server registry/connector—its docs describe a REST interface, OAuth handling, deep links, and SDK integrations (Vercel AI SDK) that let an agent connect to official MCP servers without implementing the protocol itself. This is well-documented first-party functionality directly matching the story. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the connection flow and resolution of security concerns (tool description injection, path traversal) raised in community reports that could affect trust in 'official' servers, though these don't contradict the connection capability itself.
